text: dsh-workflow-ui 是面向 DSH Web 的工作流运行时间线插件，在对话流中以时间线替换默认 workflow 工具卡和运行节点。客户端扫描脚本中的阶段、并行组和 agent 计划，让计划可在运行前呈现，并根据 workflow 事件展示阶段及子代理状态。卡片支持窄屏换行、状态弧线和子会话跳转，适合希望在会话中直观看到多步工作流进度的用户；代码未发现需要额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-workflow-ui adds a timeline to DSH Web conversations, replacing the default workflow card and run node. It scans scripts for phases, parallel groups, and planned agents, then shows their run status and links to child sessions.
想在 DSH 对话里直接看到 workflow 每个阶段和子代理的运行进度。
Show me the planned phases and agent status of a DSH workflow run inside the conversation.
希望工作流还没跑到后续步骤时，就能先查看计划中的阶段和并行任务。
dsh-workflow-ui 的功能「工作流运行时间线」：在 DSH Web 对话中替换默认 workflow 工具卡和运行节点，按阶段展示计划及执行状态，并呈现并行关系与子代理；点击子代理药丸可打开对应子会话。

dsh-workflow-ui README · 功能：- **对话内嵌卡片** — 每次 workflow 运行一张卡，长在对话流里，无需打开任何面板。
- **计划先行** — 客户端扫描 workflow 脚本（`phase()` 调用、`parallel()` 块、阶段回访），开跑前就渲染出全部计划站点、药丸占位与依赖弧线。
- **并行带** — `parallel()` 阶段渲染为抬升轨道，fork/merge 接头为圆角弧。
- **弧线** — 非相邻前向边与循环回边在轨道上空飞行：弧道按跨度分配（短跨低道、相交上推）、8px 圆角拐点、落地箭头；落入运行中站点的弧点亮为 march。宽屏画完整弧线；窄屏换行时只画同排弧，跨排回边由 `↩` 徽标承担。
- **药丸折叠** — 单站超过 5 个子代理自动折叠为「＋N」展开片；展开状态跨实时刷新保留；隐藏药丸里有运行中的会在折叠片上闪呼吸点。
- **药丸跳转子会话** — 点击药丸按 DSH 0.2.1 契约（`openSession({parentSessionId, childSessionId, mode})`，mode 传 `unknown` 由工作区自行解析）直达对应子会话；支持键盘聚焦与 Enter 触发。
- **自带 agent 预设** — 安装即向名册添加 `Workflow 编排` 预设（标准全量工具 + "多步任务主动用 workflow"的 persona 指引），卸载即移除。
- **DSH 官方图标** — StateDot 状态点（done/error = 6px 实心核，running = 中性 spinner 弧，pending = idle 点）、官方 ListPen 卡头图标、1px Check/Close 标记。
- **子代理药丸** — 逐 agent 状态 + 表情（运行中张望/眨眼），结算勾，未启动的计划占位。
- **主题与无障碍** — 经 DSH 别名 token 适配亮/暗主题，全链路尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`，状态字形带 `aria` 标签。

dsh-workflow-ui README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zuiyouli/dsh-workflow-ui
```

安装后重启一次 dsh（组合变更），再刷新页面。要求 DSH `>=0.1.0-rc.5`；已在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2` 实测，web profile。

装好后建议切换到自带的 **Workflow 编排** 预设（新会话选择器里），模型会对多步任务主动使用 workflow 编排。

dsh-workflow-ui README · 原理：两个 keyed 槽位以 `priority: -1` 影子官方渲染器（官方默认 `0`，priority 最低者渲染；本组件崩溃会自动 abdicate 回退官方）：

- `conversation.chat.node` key `workflow-run` — 数据来自官方 Definition 对持久化事件（`tool-workflow/run-start|agent-start|agent-end|run-end`）的投影，本插件只换呈现。
- `tool.call.toolview` key `workflow` — 渲染不可见标记（该行经 CSS `:has` 隐藏，0.2.1 起连同 turn-process 流程头一并隐藏），并把工具入参的脚本元数据 stash 进模块 store，供运行卡做计划先行渲染。

样式以 `<style data-plugin>` 一次性注入、卸载时移除；类名全部 `zcf-` 前缀。颜色落在 14 个局部 `--color-*` token，映射到 DSH `--dsw-alias-*`。

dsh-workflow-ui README · 边界说明：- 工具行只作为隐形数据源存在；时间线卡是会话中的唯一入口。
- 宽屏单排画完整弧线；换行模式只画同排弧，跨排依赖以 `↩` 徽标提示。
- 完成后卡片默认收成一行复盘摘要（阶段/进度/循环/失败定位/耗时，耗时需上游时间字段支持）；状态词为内置中文，locale 通道暂未接。
- 只读消费 workflow 事件，不保存任何平行编排状态。

An in-conversation workflow run timeline for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web GUI. It replaces the stock `workflow` tool card and the `workflow-run` chat node with a horizontal timeline: a rail with phase stations, agent pills, loop arcs, parallel bands — and the full **plan is visible before the run reaches it**.

中文文档见 [README.md](README.md)。

dsh-workflow-ui README · What you get：- **In-conversation card** — one card per workflow run, right in the chat flow. No panel to open, nothing to configure.
- **Plan-ahead rendering** — the card scans the workflow script client-side (`phase()` calls, `parallel()` blocks, revisited phases) and renders every planned station, pill placeholder and dependency arc before the run gets there.
- **Parallel bands** — `parallel()` phases become raised tracks with rounded fork/merge joins.
- **Arcs** — non-adjacent forward edges and loop (return) edges fly above the rail with lane assignment (short spans low, crossing spans pushed up), rounded corners and landing arrows; arcs entering a running station light up as `march`. Wide windows draw the full set; narrow re-flowed windows draw same-row arcs only, with `↩` badges carrying loop information.
- **Pill overflow** — stations with more than 5 agents collapse behind a `+N` expander; expansion persists across live re-renders, and a pulse dot signals hidden pills still running.

dsh-workflow-ui README · How it works：Two keyed slot registrations shadow the official renderers (`priority: -1`; official stays at `0`, lowest priority renders, and any crash in this component abdicates back to the official one):

dsh-workflow-ui README · How it works：- `conversation.chat.node` key `workflow-run` — data is the official Definition's projection over durable events (`tool-workflow/run-start|agent-start|agent-end|run-end`); this plugin only changes the presentation.
- `tool.call.toolview` key `workflow` — renders an invisible marker (its row is hidden via CSS `:has`, and since 0.2.1 the turn-process running header is hidden alongside), and stashes the tool input's script metadata into a module store, which run cards consume for plan-ahead rendering.

dsh-workflow-ui README · How it works：Styles are injected once as a `<style data-plugin>` element and removed on unload; all classes are `zcf-`-prefixed. Colors land on 14 local `--color-*` tokens mapped to DSH `--dsw-alias-*`.

dsh-workflow-ui README · Development：No dependencies. Node >= 20.

```bash
npm run check     # syntax checks + unit tests + build + lib checks + facade smoke
npm run preview   # generate docs/preview/preview.html (light/dark cards)
```

Screenshot a preview headlessly:

```bash

dsh-workflow-ui README · Development：Layout constants follow ZCode's public workflow presentation (station 168 / pitch 192 / lamp at +17, arc base 26 / lane 14, 6–8px rounded joins, 120/160/200/320ms motion tokens). Status dots and iconography reproduce the shapes of DSH's official `dsh-client-ui-primitives` (StateDot, ListPen, Check, Close); this plugin is not affiliated with ZCode or the DSH team.
dsh-workflow-ui README · Roadmap：See [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md) for themes per version (next up v0.3.0: collapsed finished-run summary + duration/loop metrics + failure recap).

dsh-workflow-ui README · Notes & limitations：- The tool row exists only as an invisible data source; the timeline card is the single entry point in a conversation.
- Wide single-row windows draw the full arc set; re-flowed (multi-row) windows draw same-row arcs only and mark loop targets with badges.
- Finished runs collapse to a one-line recap (phases / progress / loops / failure locations / duration — duration needs upstream time fields). Status words are built-in Chinese; the locale channel is not wired yet.
- Workflow events are consumed read-only; the plugin keeps no parallel orchestration state.
